look: Geode Squire, a D-rank GKOM variant from the Geode Knights family: empty helmet and half-armour glowing from within. Family anatomy: suits of plate armour with no body inside, filled and fused with geode crystal light. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: GKOM crystals crust its joints and run along the spine; about a quarter of the body crystallised; the crystals are amethyst geode crystal. A tennis-ball-sized GKOM core orb, dark amber with visible cracks, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Light: warm gold, white and soft rose accents, modest sun motes, feather-like light and halo rings

If it holds a weapon in image 1, the whole weapon is clearly visible in its hand, thrust forward; otherwise it strikes with claws, horns or jaws. It still faces the left side of the picture, exactly as in image 1, and keeps hold of any weapon it carries. Only the crystal growths it has in image 1, no new ones.
